original_test_intent: Perform one explicitly approved write-read transaction from the BMC management controller to one verified I2C device, validate the addressed register/device response and prove no unrelated target or shared-bus state was affected.
original_method: Master specifies OEM 0x30/0x25 with an undefined Request data payload. Review retains the command and requires vendor-defined controller, mux, address, write bytes, read count and response semantics before execution.
manual_activity: Owner/vendor verifies the BMC-owned bus/mux path and target, approves the exact address/register/write/read vector, defines expected signature and supplies a non-disruptive failure/recovery runbook.
required_inputs: Exact read count and expected response/signature
safety_requirements: Do not probe arbitrary addresses or broadcast
Do not infer BMC reachability from Linux I2C listings
Do not use sshpass or disable host-key verification
Validate full request length and address convention
Confirm register is safe to write
Validate completion, response length and device signature
Do not auto-retry, force bus recovery or reset BMC
agent_execution_scope: Validate target identity from vendor data
Capture safe pre-state and bus ownership
Present bytes, target and side effects for confirmation
Decode completion, NAK/timeout/bus error and response
Verify response signature and supported state
Stop and preserve evidence on any mismatch
engineer_actions: Approve target, transaction vector and maintenance window
Define expected response and bus-error recovery
Own shared-bus/device risk and final DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not fit without a verified package: it delegates all target-defining bytes to an operator placeholder, uses insecure access and suggests generic LAN evidence unrelated to the addressed I2C device.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After fresh approval, use protected `ipmitool raw 0x30 0x25 <complete vendor-defined bus/mux/address/write/read payload>` for one validated target and one attempt; do not substitute host-side i2c tools or probe ranges.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 0x30/0x25 family, Request data placeholder and 10/5 timing remain preserved; no bus, address, register or payload is fabricated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the OEM transaction to a vendor-documented BMC bus path and target identity, approve one exact side-effect-reviewed write/read vector, execute once and validate transport status plus device-specific response and non-target isolation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing path, payload, response oracle, ownership and recovery contract without modifying Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Linux I2C enumeration, a read-only query to another path, command completion or generic LAN data cannot prove the specified BMC-managed write-read transaction.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong mux, address or register can change a critical management device or wedge a shared bus; automated probing or retry expands that blast radius.

project_override_considerations: A vendor tool is equivalent only when it reaches the same BMC controller/mux/slave, sends the same write/read bytes, reports bus status and response, and records whether raw 0x30/0x25 remains untested.
expected_evidence: Verified BMC/firmware/controller/bus/mux and target device identity
Fresh approval with exact request bytes and side-effect review
Expected response length and decoded device signature

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source requires a potentially state-changing I2C operation but supplies only Request data and accepts transport success. DeepSeek retains the unrestricted placeholder, insecure SSH and irrelevant generic verification. Review preserves the source and constrains execution to one vendor-defined target transaction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The OEM function and write-read intent are identifiable. Controller path, target vector, expected response, approval and recovery are project execution inputs, so review can complete without guessing or probing.

review_improvement: Defines the BMC-specific bus path, exact device transaction, shared-bus ownership, response oracle and strict one-attempt recovery boundary while excluding host-path substitution and arbitrary scanning.
independent_technical_reasoning: An I2C write-read is defined by its controller path, mux state, slave address, write phase and read count; changing any one can reach a different device or register. Success at the IPMI layer is not sufficient because the target may NAK, return a plausible response from the wrong path or experience a side effect during the write phase. The safe unit is one documented vector with one attempt and a device-specific signature, not a generic request placeholder.
